attributes.title: NAON 47th Annual Congress
attributes.summary:
NAON's 47th Annual Congress for orthopaedic nurses is scheduled for May 1 to 3, 2027, in Orlando, Florida.

The congress is held at the Rosen Centre Hotel on International Drive, where NAON's group rate is $190 per night. NAON, an ANCC-accredited provider, says attendees can earn up to 20 CNE contact hours onsite and more than 43 in total with on-demand access, which full-conference registration includes.

NAON has posted its rates, with registration itself opening soon: full conference is $775 for members and $999 for nonmembers through January 4, 2027, then $835 and $1,099 until March 4, and $895 and $1,199 after that. Student and retired members pay $540 to $660, and single-day passes start at $425 for members.
